questions.subject: math
questions.question: a ≠ 0 bo‘lsa, quyidagi tizimda x va y ni toping: { ax + y = 2a,  x + ay = a + 2 }. Tizimning yagona yechimi qanday?
questions.explanation: Tizimni matritsa usuli bilan yechamiz: D = a·a‑1 = a²‑1 ≠ 0 (a ≠ ±1). X = (2a·a‑(a+2)·1)/D = (2a²‑a‑2)/(a²‑1), Y = (a·(a+2)‑2a·1)/D = (2a‑a²‑2)/(a²‑1).

questions.subject: math
questions.question: AB = 7, AC = 9, ∠A = 60° bo‘lgan uchburchak ABC ning maksimal balandligi (BC ga perpendikulyar bo‘lgan) uzunligini toping.
questions.explanation: BC uzunligini kosinus teoremasidan: BC² = 7²+9²‑2·7·9·cos60° = 49+81‑63 = 67 → BC = √67. Uchburchakning balandligi h = (2·S)/BC, S = ½·7·9·sin60° = 31.5·√3/2 = 15.75√3. Shuning uchun h = (2·15.75√3)/√67 ≈ 8√3 (aniq hisobda 8√3).

questions.question: z⁴ = 16·(cos π/3 + i sin π/3) tenglamaning barcha ildizlarini toping. Eng kichik argumentga ega ildizni tanlang.
questions.explanation: 16 = 2⁴, shuning uchun r = 2. Arg( z⁴ ) = π/3 + 2kπ → arg(z) = (π/3 + 2kπ)/4 = π/12 + k·π/2, k = 0,1,2,3. Eng kichik argument π/12 ga teng, ya'ni z = 2·(cos π/12 + i sin π/12).

questions.question: Bir qutida 5 qizil, 4 yashil va 3 ko‘k to‘p bor. Uchta to‘p tasodifiy tanlanadi. Tanlangan to‘plardan kamida biriga ko‘k rang bo‘lish ehtimoli qanday?
questions.explanation: Komplement hodisa: tanlangan hammasi ko‘k bo‘lmagan to‘plar. Bunday tanlov C(9,3) (faqat qizil va yashil). Umumiy tanlov C(12,3). Shuning uchun ehtimol 1‑C(9,3)/C(12,3).

questions.subject: math
questions.question: p>3 bo‘lgan tub son uchun p² − 1 soni nechta tub bo‘luvchiga ega?
questions.explanation: p²‑1 = (p‑1)(p+1). p>3 bo‘lsa, p odd, shuning uchun p‑1 va p+1 juft sonlar, har biri 2 ga bo‘linadi. Bundan tashqari, birinchi son 3 ga bo‘linadi (p ≡ ±1 mod 3). Shunday qilib, tub bo‘luvchilar: 2, 3, va p‑1 yoki p+1 ga qo‘shilgan boshqa bir tub (lekin p‑1 va p+1 orasida faqat 2 va 3 bo‘lishi mumkin). Natijada jami 4 ta tub bo‘luvchi (2, 3, p‑1, p+1) bo‘ladi.
